Name: Better Wild Bait Crafting Recipe
Author: Dojando
Description:
What it changes:

To craft Wild bait you need now

2 Fiber
5 Bait
1 Slime

You will get only 1 Wild Bait to balance it correctly.
In general you need the same amount of ingredients as in Vanilla but it allows you to craft Wild Bait now with normal bait which you can get from the Worm Bin thing therefore making that more useful. So instead of slaying a ton of bugs to get all the bait you need, you can finally use all the (until now) useless normal Bait :D

Downloads.Description: Download -> Unzip -> Put in Mods Folder -> Play the game
